summary: Worthington Steel filed a routine Form 8-K covering Item 2.02 results and Item 8.01 other events, not a special situation. On October 6, 2026, the company issued a news release reporting first-quarter fiscal 2027 results for the period ended August 31, 2026, and an accompanying investor presentation, with a conference call scheduled for October 7, 2026. Separately, the board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.16 per common share, payable December 28, 2026, to holders of record December 14, 2026. No transaction, stake, or advisory terms are present; watch ordinary earnings and dividend sustainability signals.
